professional_risk_authorizations_change.withCheck: exists (select 1 from public.company_risk_authorizers a where a.org_id = "professional_risk_authorizations"."org_id" and a.company_id = "professional_risk_authorizations"."company_id" and a.user_id = current_setting('app.current_actor', true)) and "professional_risk_authorizations"."authorized_by" = current_setting('app.current_actor', true)

risk_assessments_module_access.name: risk_assessments_module_access
risk_assessments_module_access.using: exists (select 1 from public.risks r where r.id = "risk_assessments"."risk_id" and r.org_id = "risk_assessments"."org_id")
risk_assessments_module_access.withCheck: exists (select 1 from public.risks r where r.id = "risk_assessments"."risk_id" and r.org_id = "risk_assessments"."org_id")

risk_assessments_measured_unit_check.name: risk_assessments_measured_unit_check
risk_assessments_measured_unit_check.value: measured_value is null or (measured_unit is not null and measured_unit <> 'qualitative_na')

risk_assessments_quantitative_criterion_.name: risk_assessments_quantitative_criterion_check
risk_assessments_quantitative_criterion_.value: criterion = 'quantitative' or (measured_value is null and measured_unit is null and tolerance_limit_value is null and nr09_conclusion is null and evaluation_method is null)

risks_module_access.name: risks_module_access
risks_module_access.using: exists (select 1 from public.ges g where g.id = "risks"."ges_id" and g.org_id = "risks"."org_id" and (exists (select 1 from public.company_modules cm where cm.org_id = "risks"."org_id" and cm.company_id = g.company_id and cm.module = 'pgr' and cm.enabled = true) or (current_setting('app.billing_simulation',true)='true' and public.billing_module_allowed("risks"."org_id",g.company_id,'pgr'))))
risks_module_access.withCheck: exists (select 1 from public.ges g where g.id = "risks"."ges_id" and g.org_id = "risks"."org_id" and (exists (select 1 from public.company_modules cm where cm.org_id = "risks"."org_id" and cm.company_id = g.company_id and cm.module = 'pgr' and cm.enabled = true) or (current_setting('app.billing_simulation',true)='true' and public.billing_module_allowed("risks"."org_id",g.company_id,'pgr'))))

pgr_document_approval_insert.name: pgr_document_approval_insert
pgr_document_approval_insert.withCheck:
"pgr_document_approvals"."org_id"=current_setting('app.current_org',true) and "pgr_document_approvals"."actor"=current_setting('app.current_actor',true)
    and exists(select 1 from public.pgr p where p.id="pgr_document_approvals"."pgr_id" and p.org_id="pgr_document_approvals"."org_id" and (p.created_by is null or p.created_by="pgr_document_approvals"."author_user_id"))
    and exists(select 1 from public.org_memberships m where m.org_id="pgr_document_approvals"."org_id" and m.user_id="pgr_document_approvals"."reviewer_user_id" and ((m.role in ('owner','org:admin','collaborator','org:member') and m.scoped_company_id is null) or (m.role in ('client','org:client') and m.scoped_company_id=(select p.company_id from public.pgr p where p.id="pgr_document_approvals"."pgr_id" and p.org_id="pgr_document_approvals"."org_id"))))
    and (("pgr_document_approvals"."kind"='assignment' and exists(select 1 from public.org_memberships m where m.org_id=current_setting('app.current_org',true) and m.user_id=current_setting('app.current_actor',true) and m.role in ('owner','org:admin'))) or ("pgr_document_approvals"."kind"='decision' and "pgr_document_approvals"."actor"="pgr_document_approvals"."reviewer_user_id"
      and "pgr_document_approvals"."assignment_id"=(select a.id from public.pgr_document_approvals a where a.org_id="pgr_document_approvals"."org_id" and a.pgr_id="pgr_document_approvals"."pgr_id" and a.kind='assignment' order by a.created_at desc,a.id desc limit 1)
      and exists(select 1 from public.pgr_document_approvals a where a.id="pgr_document_approvals"."assignment_id" and a.org_id="pgr_document_approvals"."org_id" and a.pgr_id="pgr_document_approvals"."pgr_id" and a.kind='assignment' and a.author_user_id="pgr_document_approvals"."author_user_id" and a.reviewer_user_id="pgr_document_approvals"."reviewer_user_id" and a.reviewer="pgr_document_approvals"."reviewer")
      and exists(select 1 from public.pgr_review_samples s where s.id="pgr_document_approvals"."sample_id" and s.org_id="pgr_document_approvals"."org_id" and s.pgr_id="pgr_document_approvals"."pgr_id" and s.created_by<>"pgr_document_approvals"."actor" and s.snapshot_sha256="pgr_document_approvals"."source_sha256" and s.template_sha256="pgr_document_approvals"."template_sha256")))

pgr_document_approval_shape.name: pgr_document_approval_shape
pgr_document_approval_shape.value: ("pgr_document_approvals"."kind"='assignment' and "pgr_document_approvals"."status"='pending' and "pgr_document_approvals"."assignment_id" is null and "pgr_document_approvals"."sample_id" is null) or ("pgr_document_approvals"."kind"='decision' and "pgr_document_approvals"."status" in ('accepted','changes_requested') and "pgr_document_approvals"."assignment_id" is not null and "pgr_document_approvals"."sample_id" is not null and "pgr_document_approvals"."source_sha256" is not null and "pgr_document_approvals"."template_sha256" is not null)
